verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a choice of cloud provider for managed hosting (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure) and a BYOC option inside your own AWS or Google Cloud account, where data never leaves your cloud. That gives strong control over where data lives, but no explicit region selection or residency guarantees are documented for the managed offering. Missing for 10: documented region selection for managed clusters, explicit data-residency commitments or region list, independent corroboration.
